fusions.name: Resonant Link
fusions.desc: Casts a link of raw arcana at the first enemy it meets that deals 12 damage and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Unspooling
fusions.desc: Unspools links of arcana outward that deal 30 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drawn Current
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Banked Charge
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.
